title: SADL: On the Demand-Supply Geometry of Representation Collapse
abstract: arXiv:2611.21596v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs), a well-constrained projector output does not by itself prevent representation collapse. We find that, from initialization, the encoder representation is dominated by a component shared by different inputs. A batch-normalized projector removes this component, so regularization after the projector cannot correct it, and the differences between representations shrink until they collapse. We propose SADL (Supply And Demand Loss), which keeps the original training objective and constrains the encoder directly when needed. SADL compares the representation differences that the projector output demands with the differences the encoder can retain and pass on to the projector, and adds a constraint on the encoder only when supply falls short of demand. It works with different Demand Regularizers and introduces no auxiliary networks, additional trainable parameters, or architectural changes. In

translated_title: SADL：关于表征坍缩的供需几何学
translated_abstract: 在联合嵌入预测架构中，对投影器输出的良好约束本身并不能阻止表征坍缩。我们发现，从初始化开始，编码器的表征就被不同输入所共享的一个成分所主导。带批归一化的投影器会移除该成分，因此投影器之后的正则化无法纠正这一问题，表征之间的差异会不断缩小直至坍缩。我们提出SADL（供需损失），它在保持原始训练目标的同时，在需要时直接约束编码器。SADL将投影器输出所需求的表征差异与编码器能够保留并传递给投影器的差异进行比较，仅当供给不足以满足需求时，才对编码器施加约束。该方法可以与不同的需求正则化器配合使用，并且不引入辅助网络、额外的可训练参数或架构上的更改。
tldr: 该论文揭示了JEPA中表征坍缩的供需机制——投影器移除共享成分后导致编码器供给的表征差异不足，并提出SADL方法仅在供给不足时直接约束编码器，无需额外网络或参数即可防止坍缩。
en_tdlr: SADL prevents representation collapse in JEPAs by directly constraining the encoder only when the representation differences it supplies fall short of what the projector demands, without requiring auxiliary networks or additional parameters.
